rubric_additions.rubric-1: This is a real code-changing instrumentation stage. Implement the current approved/default baseline through the real startup path,run configured project checks and normal verification,and repair failures. The unchanged logging workflow checker must actually pass on the generated app;read-only plans or Not run cannot satisfy implemented runtime coverage. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed. Determine scenario AND item proof modes from the actual path, not audit proof_level, package/test filename or suite command: isolated in-memory SDK/bridge proof is unit; decoded loopback SDK export is unit+otlp; an actual application-owned helper/setup test can legitimately be app_test; full_runtime requires the claimed normal application path. Do not map every focused scenario to app_test or every item to full_runtime. Item mode describes its direct assertion scope: actual runtime proof can legitimately coexist with clearly scoped ancillary focused/incomplete scenarios. Do not fail merely because those are attached; fail an unsupported combined claim or mechanical first-scenario mode/visibility that misrepresents the item evidence. For a required reference or exact source fact, inspect the actual tool-visible slice; a successful command, complete archived stdout or file present in the bundle cannot substitute for content omitted by a truncated response. Retrieve the missing selected section before relying on it; no exhaustive unselected-source read or model-comprehension claim is required.
rubric_additions.rubric-4: Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.
rubric_additions.rubric-6: A selected reuse probe must exercise the same execution unit with distinct work-item contexts and context-free work; fresh concurrent workers sharing one context do not prove that reuse or request isolation. For a selected missing-transfer control, pair a successful handoff with an omitted-transfer case on the same supported path. Independently observe valid caller SDK context at scheduling in both cases, retain the relevant operation/worker/input conditions, and vary only the selected capture/transfer mechanism. Submission after the caller scope ends correctly propagates empty scheduling context and is not this negative; neither is a direct outside-context emit. Assert the expected received context versus loss, preserving caller detach/restore. Do not add business worker behavior merely for an optional focused capability probe, or remove a focused probe already bound.
rubric_additions.rubric-8: Inspect all framework records captured by the selected bridge, not only a fixed-message/application-logger allowlist; separately routed SDK diagnostics retain their own boundary. A policy violation in framework/container records captured by the newly added or selected log pipeline is part of that authorized logging baseline, including a direct invocation without an audit. Do not defer a supported logging-only sanitizer as new custom business instrumentation requiring another audit; inspect and repair the selected boundary, preserve immutable existing audit IDs and explicit exclusions, and rerun the failing probe. Evidence of a genuinely unsupported hook can retain the gap. For each selected negative trigger, resolve its actual handled or escaping error branch and producer before choosing a repair or source-supported no-action disposition. Same-endpoint rejection and unhandled failure need not share a producer or hook. A retained source file or trail template alone does not resolve that mechanism. For unresolved capability, name the exact source symbol/event/API edge, owner and next inspection/probe observation that distinguishes supported repair from an unsupported boundary. Retain a source-bound producer/call-site → native event → supported policy-boundary hook/action → later renderers → native/SDK outputs trail, with sentinel-absence AND permitted-category assertions at each covered output. For asserted event order, distinguish registration/enqueue from actual callback invocation and completion relative to synchronous work and teardown, using establishing source or supported ordering evidence. A deferred callback can run after response/socket teardown yet before SDK/writer capture; require the actual selected policy boundary, not an invented earlier lifecycle point. An unachievable required boundary remains a gap. A deny-only hook cannot preserve a required category. An unresolved producer/event/API edge needs its owner and exact next source/probe check, not a generic formatter assessment. Apply shared record predicates through explicit operation bindings or the complete shared/global scan or parameterization with covered outputs, phases and operation witnesses accepted by criterion2. A native producer investigation needs the matching dependency implementation/public API/artifact or permitted bytecode receipt and inspected symbol, or an exact unavailable artifact/edge and discriminating next observation. SDK mapper/autoconfiguration code and dependency/POM metadata alone do not establish that native producer path. Prioritizing this work is guidance, not a required tool-call chronology; equivalent complete evidence remains valid.
rubric_additions.rubric-11: Match only the fault/operation combinations actually selected by the bound contract to their own native output, diagnostics, progress and unrelated-signal receipts. A one-operation stall cannot cover a selected refusal or another required operation; do not invent an unselected cross-product. Keep unexecuted combinations open while retaining independently proven direct item scope. Derive this fault verdict from its own selected contract; a separate stop-control gap is relevant only when it prevents a necessary fault/isolation predicate or prerequisite.
rubric_additions.rubric-12: Retain distinct trial storage on the actual filesystem: case-only names may refer to one overwritten file. Check each retained result input/case identity against the claimed trial; two case aliases cannot establish separate true/TRUE controls. If an authorized separate readback context is used, its advice is not execution or approval proof: the parent verifies concrete findings, repairs within its authority and reruns affected checks or retains the unresolved gaps. Unavailable or unwarranted delegation does not change the same self-readback obligations; no extra model invocation is required for credit.
rubric_additions.rubric-13: Before rebinding a process-wide native logging default, resolve the captured handler's actual output path: the built-in Go slog default may dynamically route through the standard logger that SetDefault rewires, so nesting it can recurse or deadlock. An application-owned logger may retain it without rebinding the default. A writer adapter alone does not prove preserved native formatting/level markers; assert original enablement, formatting, sinks, ownership and multiplicity. Keep this native cycle distinct from SDK diagnostic feedback; do not require handler replacement when the existing route is safe. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. When adding a fallback, include representative Resource encodings accepted by that installed owner, including whitespace variants where supported, and prove normal-launch preservation rather than only compact helper inputs. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity. When the existing host checker supplies operator identity profiles, credit only its retained normal-launch assertions. Passing Resource-only, explicit-name and source-supported whitespace profiles can establish supplied service.name, service.version and unrelated Resource-key preservation on the observed application logs/spans. They do not prove metrics Resource, fully absent/default identity, percent-encoded Resource, headers or component maturity. Keep every other selected case/disposition required, and do not infer proof from flag presence or another run. Audit may allocate that feasible host-check scope without claiming execution; instrumentation/verification must retain the actual profile outcomes. When service.version or another resource field is explicitly promised, require its source-backed expected value and preservation assertion at the declared boundary; name/environment-only checks do not close it. Genuinely unavailable/unpromised optional version metadata remains absent, not invented. For normal-launch identity variants, construct the actual child environment with conflicting inherited keys removed, account for active loader/profile inputs, and inspect the received Resource. For selected endpoint/header/activation policy, resolve the actual highest-priority supported input, including programmatic/file/loader inputs and launcher/build-tool child-VM properties where applicable. When the policy requires the identified local receiver, compare the effective transport, authority/port and applicable signal path to the detected/approved receiver or explicitly owned authorized fixture tuple. Loopback locality alone is not receiver identity; preserve supported resolution and authorized alternative receivers without a universal fixed-port recipe or application runtime discovery. A conflicting value at that winning input needs effective destination, credential-boundary, activation and independent-signal preservation assertions at the selected boundary; environment-only checks cannot prove a policy another layer overrides. Use the existing SDK/configuration owner without a new parser or silent operator-policy override; retain an exact unresolved boundary where necessary. An inherited explicit service name cannot establish a resource-only or absent-identity trial. For newly added or changed application-owned Resource initialization that combines supplied Resource attributes with native/default detectors, follow the selected SDK's actual detector order and merge precedence. Where those selected sources can write the same promised operator-owned key, bind a representative collision (for example host.name when host detection is selected) to preservation through that initialization at its claimed proof boundary. A service-name-only helper cannot prove an explicitly promised unrelated attribute survives a later detector. Audit plans this control; implementation/verification prove the selected owned path. Do not add custom parsers or require certification of unchanged, unselected detectors. For selected OTLP/HTTP endpoint resolution, use a signal-specific URL as-is (root path when absent). Preserve the complete generic base path and append v1/<signal> after a separating slash; a signal-looking suffix is not permission to replace it. Reuse SDK resolution where available rather than requiring a custom parser.
rubric_additions.rubric-14: For a selected or newly app-owned standard environment Boolean reader, bind raw `true`/`TrUe`, nontrue inputs such as `1`/`t`/`T` and padded `true` to that actual reader/branch. Do not use selector trimming or unqualified strconv.ParseBool: only the raw case-insensitive literal `true` resolves true. Preserve invalid-nonempty warning SHOULD strength and unchanged SDK/file-loader ownership; do not demand unused SDK parser permutations. Selected controls may satisfy a duty through a source-proven implication along that same call path and inputs: require the source/catch/order binding, not a repeated literal assertion. Synchrony or eventual completion does not prove the orthogonal nonblocking recommendation.
